purpose: Evaluates each conflict-handling safety property against executable proof (public-signal-conflict-resolution.test.ts unit + conflicting-public-signal-end-to-end.db.test.ts DB).

properties.how: conflicting/uncertain sets route to validation/reassessment/owner-review/missing-data/monitor-only, never a confident action.
one weak signal → WEAK_SINGLE_SIGNAL → validation; never a high-confidence conclusion.
repeated weak signals → REPEATED_WEAK_SIGNALS → reassessment/validation, never an accusation (no fraud/negligent/fired label).
official strengthens PUBLISHED requirements only; a public complaint still requires internal verification (OFFICIAL_SOURCE_CONFLICT → data task).
a recent negative reopens an older 'fixed' claim (MIXED_RECENCY → verification); a positive can never close an issue without executed-correction + outcome evidence.
duplicate/near-duplicate signals collapse to one cluster; one collective task per case.
PII stripped upstream and never carried into the package/task/audit.
injection aggregated to blockedUnsafeActions; never changes classification, route, verification, or authority.
money/ROI/win-probability blocked and never a governed figure; Zod refinement forbids currency/% in summaries.
growth + weak/unresolved quality/capacity → HIGH_RISK_UNRESOLVED, fix/validate first, scale blocked-before-proof.
one governed collective action per workspace; no raw/injection/PII text in the persisted task.
each conflict case is scoped to its workspace; the tender collective task never leaks into laundry.
no signals → resolve returns null; the workspace persists nothing.
the collective package is Zod-validated (gate-consistency + no-fabricated-money refinements); a tampered package is rejected.
